intake_quote: Prove that critical bond percolation on Z^2 at p = 1/2 is conformally invariant in the scaling limit (Cardy's formula and convergence of interfaces to SLE(6))

original_primary_source.location: Chapter II, Section 4, PDF page 26 (P25), printed page 24
original_primary_source.quote: on Z^2 at pc = 1/2, proving the conformal invariance is still a challenging open problem
original_primary_source.scope_note: The original note states the square-lattice conformal-invariance challenge; the intake's explicit Cardy plus SLE6 wording is a sharper working formulation, not a verbatim quotation from the note.

primary_claim.author: Wang Zhou
primary_claim.location: Theorem 2 and Corollary 1.1, PDF page 6 (web PDF index P5)
primary_claim.theorem_scope: Weak convergence of one Dobrushin exploration path to SLE6, given Caratheodory convergence and the paper's Condition C; Cardy crossing formula as corollary.
primary_claim.proof_status: unrefereed here; existence of preprint claim only

older_preprint_notice.notice: Authors call it preliminary and report critical comments, promising revision.

independent_primary_context.scope: A stronger full-plane nested CLE limit for FK q in [1,4] remains presented as a conjecture; rotational invariance is proved but is distinguished from conformal invariance. This does not decide the narrower exploration-path preprint.

reason: A primary preprint claims the narrower target; a later primary survey still presents the stronger full-plane limit as conjectural. Neither its theorem proof nor outside acceptance has been established by this audit.

prior_attempt_correction.correct: q=1 FK parafermionic spin sigma=1/3 under the standard Definition 3 convention
prior_attempt_correction.primary_source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1208.3787, Definition 3, PDF page 7 (P6): sin(sigma*pi/2)=sqrt(q)/2 with sigma in [0,1]
